P.name: Inherent Glamour
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Neeko''' has a collection of disguises to take on the appearance of allied {{tip|champions}}, displayed on her ''Disguise Menu''. She can use the menu to activate a disguise, switch her current disguise to a different one, or deactivate the current disguise by selecting herself, all of which place ''Inherent Glamour'' on a {{fd|0.5}}-second cooldown. Taking damage from a champion or {{tip|turret}} while not disguised puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown.
P.description4: Breaking the disguise via dying, being immobilized or taking damage from a turret puts ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 2-second cooldown, entering the enemy spawn platform does not put it on cooldown, and all other methods of breaking the disguise put ''Inherent Glamour'' on a 1-second cooldown.
P.description5: ''Inherent Glamour's disguise is not deactivated from {{ai|Pop Blossom|Neeko}} until after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its cast. '''Neeko''' cannot activate Inherent Glamour while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables casting abilities.''

Q.name: Blooming Burst
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' tosses a seed that bursts upon landing at the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description2: If the burst kills an enemy or hits a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, the seed blooms after {{fd|0.75}} seconds to burst again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the same area. This may occur up to 2 times per cast.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Subsequent Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|60+35*2 to 260+135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60+25*2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: Each bloom deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Shapesplitter
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Neeko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Shapesplitter'',  which refreshes on subsequent attacks and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes them all to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and grant her {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. This attack deals {{as|75 '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|30 to 170}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' creates a {{tip|clone}} of her {{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|current form}}, after which they both instantly become {{tip|invisible}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and gain {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. ''Shapesplitter'' can be recast at any time while the clone is active.
W.description3:
The clone lasts for 3 seconds, moves a fixed distance in the target direction, and is {{tip|untargetable}} to allies and for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of its lifespan to enemies. If the clone takes [[damage]], it will disappear prematurely after {{fd|0.5}} seconds.

Casting an ability, summoner spell, item active, or starting a {{tip|channel}} causes the clone to stop moving. Additionally, the clone plays the {{tt|casting animations|See notes}} for ''{{ai|Blooming Burst|Neeko}}'' and ''{{ai|Tangle-Barbs|Neeko}}'' as well as ''{{ais|Pop Blossom|Neeko}}'' {{tt|visual effects|See notes, only visible from the enemy's perspective}} whenever '''Neeko''' casts them. The clone will also play the animation of her next [[Emoting|expression]] or {{si|Recall}} for a {{tt|set duration|See notes}} that overrides its original duration and will become unable to move while doing so.
W.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Neeko''' sends her clone to the target location if it is not playing an expression or {{si|Recall}} animation.

E.name: Tangle-Barbs
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' slings a magical spiral in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 210}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|0.7 to 1.5}} seconds}}
E.description2: If the spiral hits at least one enemy, it grows in size and its speed and root duration is increased.

R.name: Pop Blossom
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Neeko''' winds up spiritual essence over {{fd|1.25}} seconds and highlights an area around herself, which is visible to enemies unless she is ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguised}}''. If '''Neeko''' is in a ''{{ai|Inherent Glamour|Neeko|disguise}}'', it will break after {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the duration.
R.description2: After winding up, the cast time begins and '''Neeko''' leaps upward, {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} nearby enemies for {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
R.description3: When the cast time ends, she lands to emit a burst of energy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
